meta.title: Random Number Generator - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Generate random integers or decimals with custom range and count.
steps_random-number_1Desc: Enter minimum and maximum values for your random number range. You can generate integers or decimals within any range supported by JavaScript.
steps_random-number_2Desc: Click Generate to produce a truly random number within your specified range. Generate single values or multiple numbers at once for batch use.
steps_random-number_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the generated number(s). Use for dice rolls, lottery simulations, randomized test data, game mechanics, or statistical sampling.
desc: Generate random integers or decimals with custom range and count.
